title: S5 'can I stay until Sunday?' — LIVE NL intake + REPLAY hotel.search through traveller self-funded hotel extension

boundaries.note: natural-language stay-extension request interpreted by LIVE Model Studio into the frozen ChangeRequest schema; zod-validated, fail-closed on ambiguity
G1/G2 hotel.search evidence from curated Downtown Core / Marina Bay Nuitée REPLAY recording (same corpus as REPLAY manifest)

steps.description: Traveller asks in natural language to stay until Sunday and self-fund the hotel extension

body.text: Can I stay until Sunday? Please extend my hotel checkout to 2026-10-04T11:00:00+08:00. Prefer the Concorde Hotel Singapore (nuitee-hotel-id lp21d9f) — I'll pay for the extension myself.

assert.description: the NL stay-extension request is accepted
the request came from interpretation, not a pre-structured target
the model maps a stay extension to a stay change
a recovery case opens for the request
at least one implication is derived from the interpreted target
FUNDED_WINDOW allocates the personal extension increment to the traveller when a stayCheckOut anchor is present

steps.description: G1/G2 planning issues hotel.search (REPLAY) and enumerates stay-extension strategies

assert.description: the planning loop completed against hotel evidence
G1/G2 issues a scoped hotel.search for the stay extension
Nuitée REPLAY evidence resolves
candidate replacement/extension stays come from hotel.search evidence
candidates name a real property from provider evidence
feasible hotel candidates are ranked into a best strategy
the case advanced through the planning stage

steps.description: Hotel extension intent under traveller self-funded authority (no organiser)

assert.description: the hotel strategy was staged as a validated action intent
personal extension increment is traveller-funded via FUNDED_WINDOW
the allocation cites the governing policy rule
the traveller-funded incremental amount is surfaced
traveller self-funded hotel.modify stays on traveller authority — no organiser approval
the case waits on traveller authority, not organiser escalation

steps.description: Observe the recovery case after the authority stage

assert.description: the case belongs to the requesting traveller's trip
the evaluated hotel options remain visible on the case
